title: How Do I Advertise on CTV | Comcast Advertising

facts.fact: Comcast Advertising states that connected TV (CTV) represents more than a third of total TV viewing.
facts.quote: In fact, CTV represents more than a third of total TV viewing,1 so there’s no better time to learn how to advertise on CTV.

facts.fact: Comcast Advertising says CTV ads most commonly run as 15- or 30-second video spots.
facts.quote: CTV ads typically look like traditional TV commercials, most commonly 15- or 30-second video spots, but they are served in streaming environments with fewer ad breaks.

facts.fact: Comcast Advertising states that CTV advertisers typically pay based on impressions delivered to their desired audience.
facts.quote: CTV advertisers typically pay based on impressions delivered to their desired audience.

facts.fact: Comcast Advertising says CTV costs vary by targeting, market size, ad length, and demand, and the page gives no specific price figures.
facts.quote: Connected TV advertising costs vary based on targeting, market size, ad length, and demand
